verses.text: “Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.”

end.gold: Today, before Maghrib: pray Asr. Don't wait for next year.

captions: 4:05 p.m. Rain. The bus stop across from the mosque.
Your notes app. Every New Year, one line: “Start praying.”
Across the street, the adhan for Asr. You look at your shoes.
The bus pulls in. “Next year,” you whisper. Again.
There's always a next bus. Not always a next year.
You let the bus go. You cross the street, soaking wet.
Last row. You don't remember every word. You pray anyway.
Your first sujood in six years. It feels like coming home.

post.caption:
6 years of “next year.” Allah is still calling. 🤍

There's always a next bus. There isn't always a next year. The adhan across the street was calling you, too.

“Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.” (39:53)

Today, before Maghrib: pray Asr. Don't wait for next year.
